task.title: Follow NC State Password Guidelines
task.shortdesc: Creating secure passwords and protecting your university accounts and credentials using NC State-specific recommendations.

context.p: NC State Unity password rules and credential protection standards apply uniformly to all students, faculty, and staff.

step.cmd: Create a longer passphrase or sentence that achieves a minimum strength rating of "Strong" and does not exceed 100 characters.
Ensure your Unity password does not contain your Unity ID, an apostrophe ('), a pipe (|), or leading and trailing spaces.
Choose a completely new password rather than reusing a previously used Unity password or making simple modifications to an old password.
Never share your Unity password with anyone, and never reuse your NC State password on personal accounts or external websites.
Avoid saving or syncing passwords in web browsers on shared or public computers, such as campus lab workstations.
